description: This file defines the FooTable.Column class, which manages properties and behaviors of table columns in the FooTable plugin, including construction, defining properties, creating cells, and formatting data.

classes.name: F.Column
classes.description: Represents a table column with properties such as type, visibility, style, and methods for parsing, formatting, and creating cells.

methods.name: construct
methods.description: Initializes a new column instance with properties like type, virtual, $el, index, and internal, then defines additional properties and creates the header element.

methods.name: define
methods.description: Sets column properties such as hidden, visible, name, title, style, classes, parser, and formatter based on the provided definition object.

methods.name: $create
methods.description: Ensures the $el property is a jQuery object representing the header cell, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: parser
methods.description: Parses a cell value or element to extract a string representation for display or processing.

methods.name: formatter
methods.description: Formats a parsed value for display in the table cell.

methods.name: createCell
methods.description: Creates a cell object for a given row based on the column's properties.
